scope: Independent read-only production review. Full 99-entry catalog mapped; replay does not imply all 99 full gameplay prerequisites exercised.

verification.native_reason: Godot executable unavailable; static code and hook review only

residual_limits: Godot execution and rendering require an engine check outside this container.
Native and browser share concepts but are not pixel-identical; related spell motifs intentionally share bounded visual families.
No recovery spell emission or escape-grapple spell emission was invented to satisfy animation coverage.
All-catalog replay invokes Game.spell_effect directly; only the listed 12 spells use full production WebSocket cast dispatch.
Headless Chromium desktop/touch timings do not establish physical Android frame rate.
